title: Fish (pond_fish/items/<id>/pond_fish.json)
description: A pond fish as the house view draws it, mostly seen from above: a tapered body, its fins and its varieties (colours and patterns). The view builds every fish itself, with a robe of its own drawn from its variety.

latin.description: Scientific name (Cyprinus rubrofuscus). Unique in the catalog.

length.description: Length of an adult fish, from the snout to the end of the tail, in metres: the usual one, and the bounds offered in a pond.

body.description: Shape of the body, as shares of the length.

width.description: Widest part of the body seen from above.

height.description: Highest part of the body seen from the side.

fins.description: short fins, or long flowing ones (butterfly koi, veiltail goldfish).

speed.description: Cruising speed, in metres per second.

depth.description: Where it stays when the water is warm: near the surface, in the middle, or near the bottom. Every fish goes down in cold water.

school.description: Swims in a group rather than alone.

varieties.description: The colour varieties offered for this fish (the first one by default).
